description: This PHP source file defines the Language Data Transfer Object (DTO) class within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends a normalizable DTO base class and includes methods for converting employee language data into an array format and mapping fields to getter methods. It is used for handling language-related data of employees within the HRM system's reporting module.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) for employee language information, capable of normalizing its data for reporting purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Language DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the employee's language data into a normalized array based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of field names to getter method chains used to retrieve corresponding data.
